# Argus

> Self-hosted company of AI agents for software projects.

## Start Here

- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): exact source-checkout steps for Codex, Claude Code,
  and coding agents.
- [Argus Live Onboarding Skill](skills/argus-live-onboarding/SKILL.md): an
  agent-facing installer skill for Codex, Claude Code, and skill-aware coding
  agents. It inspects local projects, asks only missing setup questions, writes
  private config, and proves live operation.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): first local echo-engine runtime loop.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): common setup, safety, channel, engine, and operational
  questions for new users.
- [Updating](docs/updating.md): update, rollback, restart, and uninstall paths
  for pipx, uv, and source installs.
- [Showcase](docs/showcase.md): common `chat-only`, `monitor-only`, and
  `pm-propose-pr` deployment paths with proof points.
- [Public Launch Checklist](docs/public-launch.md): repo, GitHub, package, and
  smoke-test checks before making Argus public.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/dangogit/argus/releases): current source
  distribution and wheel artifacts.
- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/dangogit/argus/discussions): setup
  questions for install, Slack, Telegram, connectors, and `go-live`.
- [Support Policy](SUPPORT.md): what to include in public setup questions and
  what to redact.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): config model, defaults, teams,
  projects, secrets, and safety policy.
- [Live Onboarding](docs/live-onboarding.md): smoke-to-live flow, manager roles,
  continuous workers, draft PR agents, launchd caveats, and stable webhook URLs.
- [Inbound Channels](docs/inbound.md): WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and local
  webhook smoke tests.
- [Live Slack Setup](docs/slack-live.md): Slack app scopes, signing secret,
  tunnel, one-channel-per-team routing, and smoke commands.
- [Slack App Manifest](examples/slack-app-manifest.yaml): copy this into
  Slack's "Create New App from manifest" flow after replacing the request URL.
- [Engines](docs/engines.md): `echo`, `scripted`, `codex`, `claude-code`, and
  `hermes` engine names.
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): launchd/systemd, backups, watchdog, and
  always-on jobs.
- [Threat Model](docs/threat-model.md): approval gates, outbound actions, and
  secret boundaries.

## Install From GitHub

Unix-like shell:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dangogit/argus/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
argus --version
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dangogit/argus/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
argus --version
```

Manual `pipx` install:

```bash
pipx install --python python3.12 "git+https://github.com/dangogit/argus.git"
argus --version
```

Package name is `argus-agent`; installed command is `argus`. Keep the GitHub
install path as primary until PyPI publishing is live.

## Install From Source

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

docker compose up -d postgres
until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U argus -d argus; do sleep 1; done

argus init --config argus.yaml --force
export ARGUS_CONFIG="$PWD/argus.yaml"
export ARGUS_CONFIG_V2="$PWD/argus.yaml"
export ARGUS_DB_DSN="host=127.0.0.1 port=5440 dbname=argus user=argus password=argus"
export ARGUS_RUN_ROOT="$PWD/run"

argus db migrate
argus validate
argus validate-roles
argus doctor
```

## First Agent Loop

```bash
argus submit --team demo "Review this repo and propose one small improvement"
argus up --iterations 1
argus status
```

Start with `echo`. Switch to `codex` or `claude-code` only after local smoke
passes, then run `argus doctor --live`.

## Operational Onboarding

```bash
argus onboard project /absolute/path/to/project --mode chat-only \
  --config /absolute/path/to/private/argus.yaml \
  --out-dir /absolute/path/to/private/onboarding \
  --channel slack --channel-id C1234567890

argus doctor --deep --json
argus go-live --mode chat-only --public-url https://argus.example.com/slack
```

Onboarding modes are `chat-only`, `monitor-only`, and `pm-propose-pr`.
Generated files are private: `argus.yaml`, `argus.env.example.generated`, and
`argus.onboarding.md`. Secret values are never copied from `.env`.
Load private env files with `ARGUS_ENV_FILES=/absolute/path/to/argus.env`, or
use `set -a` before sourcing. Vercel sources can use `VERCEL_TOKEN`; local Mac
installs may omit `secret_ref` after `vercel login` so Argus refreshes CLI auth.
Sentry sources need `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`, `SENTRY_ORG`, and `SENTRY_PROJECT`.
PostHog sources need `POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY`, `POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID`, and
`POSTHOG_HOST`. Browser DSNs and `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` do not prove
monitoring is live.
Use `--require-source-type sentry` and `--require-source-type posthog` with
`doctor --deep` or `go-live` when those providers are required; missing source
types then block `operational` status.
Use `--require-team-source-type team:type` when one specific project needs that
provider; one configured source must not prove every team.
Prefer `--require-each-team-source-type sentry` and
`--require-each-team-source-type posthog` when every configured team must have
that provider.

## Verification

```bash
python scripts/gate.py
python -m pytest tests/python/test_no_u2014.py tests/python/test_package.py -q
python scripts/public_launch_check.py --repo dangogit/argus --pypi-package argus-agent
python scripts/public_launch_check.py --repo dangogit/argus --pypi-package argus-agent --json
```

Dashboard checks live under `dashboard` and are separate.

## Community And Support

- Setup questions: <https://github.com/dangogit/argus/discussions>
- Bugs and feature requests: <https://github.com/dangogit/argus/issues>
- Security reports: use GitHub Security Advisories, not public issues.
- Public setup questions should include OS, install path, `argus --version`,
  onboarding mode, and redacted `argus doctor --deep --json` output.
- Never paste tokens, webhook secrets, phone numbers, private repo names,
  customer data, Slack payloads with user data, or full `.env` files.

## Public Launch External Checks

Agent installers must verify external GitHub state before calling a public
launch ready:

```bash
python scripts/public_launch_check.py --repo dangogit/argus --pypi-package argus-agent

gh repo view dangogit/argus \
  --json description,homepageUrl,isPrivate,hasDiscussionsEnabled,hasIssuesEnabled,latestRelease,repositoryTopics

gh api repos/dangogit/argus --jq '{private, has_pages, homepage}'
gh api repos/dangogit/argus/community/profile --jq '{health_percentage}'
gh release view --repo dangogit/argus --json tagName,name,publishedAt,url
gh run list --repo dangogit/argus --limit 5
```

Code changes do not prove repo visibility, GitHub Pages, PyPI trusted
publishing, or hosted Actions runner health. Treat private repo status, missing
Pages, missing PyPI package, and zero-step Actions failures as external
blockers until GitHub and PyPI prove otherwise.
The script reports these as named checks including `repo.visibility`,
`docs.homepage`, `actions.ci`, `actions.release`, and `package.pypi`.
